content: The information provided about this product is intended to offer general details and does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. It is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and how it relates to your health. Side Effects: This medication may cause increased vaginal or urethral burning, itching, pain, or mild abdominal cramps. It is prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. If you are in the U.S. or Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other azole antifungal agents (e.g., clotrimazole, fluconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Ask your doctor if it is safe to engage in sexual intercourse while using this product. Note that this medication may weaken rubber products such as latex condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps, potentially leading to failure and resulting in pregnancy. Avoid using these products during treatment and for three days after completing treatment. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor. Pregnant women should exercise caution when using the vaginal applicator. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If this medication is swallowed, it may be harmful. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Prevention of Vaginal Yeast Infections: To help prevent vaginal yeast infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. It is not applicable for missed doses. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information tailored to your specific health needs. For formulary information, create a list of plans to compare the status of this drug with others in the same class. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current details.
